name: UI Rotation + Direct Booking Restore
key_results: Responsive Arbor Vista mountain/wordmark logo is visible on desktop and mobile.
Cabin hero uses a dark full-width overlay for readable white text.
Only one image is visible per rotating area; slides fade every 3 seconds.
Cabin kitchen rotates only the 2 approved charcoal kitchen images.
Full four-step Book Direct form is present and Step 1 advances to Step 2.
Root pages are portable across ArborVista-Labs, ArborVista-Retreat, and a custom domain.
Desktop and mobile pages have no horizontal overflow.
No browser page errors were detected in focused v4.3.1 testing.
